files.README.md:
# tidewatch

no_std Rust firmware for small solar-powered tide gauges built on the ESP32-C6.
A pressure sensor on a buoy cable is sampled periodically and readings go out over
Wi-Fi/MQTT. Shared logic lives in the host-testable `tide-core` crate.
files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "tidewatch"
version = "0.7.2"
edition = "2021"
description = "ESP32-C6 tide gauge firmware (esp-hal + embassy)"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[dependencies]
esp-hal = "0.22"
esp-hal-embassy = "0.5"
embassy-executor = "0.6"
embassy-net = "0.5"
rust-mqtt = { version = "0.3", default-features = false }
tide-core = { path = "tide-core" }

# Ledgerly API

Rails API backend for Ledgerly, B2B invoicing for small European agencies.
Postgres, multi-tenant by account, PDF invoices, outbound webhooks.
files.Gemfile:

gem "rails", "~> 7.2.1"
gem "pg", "~> 1.5"

gem "acts_as_tenant"
gem "rack-attack"
gem "strong_migrations"
gem "valvat"

group :development, :test do
  gem "rspec-rails"
  gem "bullet"
end

files.README.md:
# Glyphbar

A tiny macOS menu-bar app for text snippets: type an abbreviation or hit a hotkey,
get the expansion pasted into whatever app is frontmost. SwiftUI, updates via Sparkle.
files.project.yml:
name: Glyphbar
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: dev.mira
targets:
  Glyphbar:
    type: application
    platform: macOS
    sources: [Sources]
  GlyphbarTests:
    type: bundle.unit-test
    platform: macOS
    sources: [Tests]

files.README.md:
# orchard-infra

Infrastructure as code for Orchard Health's AWS accounts (staging + prod).
Root modules per environment under envs/, reusable modules under modules/.

# moe-lab

Experiments with sparse mixture-of-experts transformers: routing variants,
load-balancing losses, expert capacity. PyTorch + FSDP, configs in configs/.
files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "moelab"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "Sparse mixture-of-experts research code"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["torch>=2.5", "numpy", "pyyaml", "datasets"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

notes.content: tidewatch is no_std Rust firmware for an ESP32-C6: it samples an MS5837 pressure sensor on a buoy cable and publishes water-level readings over Wi-Fi to an MQTT broker.
notes.label: store

notes.content: We build on bare-metal esp-hal with the embassy async executor rather than the std esp-idf-svc stack.
notes.why: the esp-idf-svc build came out around 1.9 MB versus roughly 600 KB on esp-hal
notes.label: store

notes.content: The C6 is RISC-V, so plain stable rustup with target riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf is enough; no espup / Xtensa toolchain needed.
notes.label: store

notes.content: This applies to all my repos, not just the firmware: imperative commit subjects under 60 characters, with a conventional prefix like fix:, feat: or chore:.
notes.label: store

notes.content: To flash a board and watch its serial output: `cargo run --release`. The runner in .cargo/config.toml is `espflash flash --monitor`.
notes.label: store

notes.content: The pressure sensor is read every 30 seconds.
notes.label: store

notes.content: Level readings go to MQTT topic `tide/<station-id>/level` at QoS 1; the payload is CBOR, not JSON.
notes.label: store

notes.content: A heartbeat goes to `tide/<station-id>/alive` every 300 seconds at QoS 0.
notes.label: store

notes.content: The MS5837 randomly NACKs at 400 kHz on the long buoy cable. Keep the I2C bus at 100 kHz.
notes.label: store

notes.content: The cable down to the buoy is about 4 m of unshielded wire; at that length bus capacitance is far beyond what fast-mode I2C tolerates.
notes.label: store

notes.content: MQTT broker is a self-hosted Mosquitto on a small Hetzner VPS (mqtt.mira.dev:8883).
notes.label: store

notes.content: Station Wi-Fi is SSID harbour-iot with password Tid3!Watch2026 — just hardcode it in main.rs for now.
notes.label: reject_secret

notes.content: Host tests: `cargo test -p tide-core --target aarch64-apple-darwin`. The firmware crate has no tests; all testable logic lives in tide-core.
notes.label: store

notes.content: GitHub Actions builds the firmware for riscv32imac, runs the tide-core tests and clippy with -D warnings. There is no hardware-in-the-loop stage.
notes.label: store

notes.content: ESP32-C6 深睡唤醒以后普通 static 变量会被清零，只有 RTC fast memory 里的能保留；跨睡眠的计数器要标 #[ram(rtc_fast)]。
notes.label: store

notes.content: Task watchdog timeout is 8 s, so a publish cycle has to finish comfortably inside that window.
notes.label: store

notes.content: Station 2 once froze for two days after a botched Wi-Fi reconnect until somebody walked out and power-cycled it; that incident is the reason the hardware watchdog exists.
notes.label: store

notes.content: MQTT keepalive interval is 60 s.
notes.label: store

notes.content: 分区表是两个 OTA 槽，每个 1.5 MiB，另外还有 64 KiB 的 nvs 分区。

notes.content: The XIAO ESP32C6 boards we use carry 4 MiB of flash.
